passages.title: Job Application Workshop
passages.intro: Guidance for people seeking work or business training
paras: Participants are encouraged to bring an up-to-date résumé. Each workshop session lasts 90 minutes.
Advance registration is required because seating is limited. Practice interviews take place in small groups.
Attendance does not guarantee a job offer. Advisers can help participants navigate online job applications.
A job-search checklist is emailed after the session. The workshop is free for newcomers to the city.

passages.title: Workplace Shift Handover
paras: At the end of a shift, the outgoing worker records unfinished tasks. Stock shortages must be entered in the digital handover log.
Urgent hazards must be reported directly to the supervisor immediately. The incoming team checks the handover notes before beginning work.
Handover notes should contain facts, not personal opinions. Reports of equipment faults must include the machine's asset number.
Confidential details must be entered only in the secure reporting system. A supervisor reviews and signs off serious incident reports.

passages.title: Rental Viewing Checklist
passages.intro: Important rules for residents and visitors
paras: Prospective tenants must arrange viewings with the rental agent. The checklist advises applicants to test taps and water pressure.
Applicants should confirm which utilities are included before signing a lease. Smoke alarms should be checked during the viewing.
Tenants are advised to photograph the inventory and existing damage. Any agreed changes should be recorded in writing in the lease.
The agent may ask for references from previous landlords or employers. Before paying a holding deposit, applicants should obtain its terms in writing.
